title: E7: worker turn diet — allowedTools per role, bus-only MCP config, tool-call budget lines in prompts
spec:
Measured 2026-09-19: an execute run averages 2.46M cache-read tokens over ~30-40 turns at a ~24k-token baseline context per turn; a review 0.73M with up to 28 Bash calls; a probe showed --strict-mcp-config saves ~2k tokens per turn. spawn.TOOLS is defined per role but run_claude never passes it (dead config). Change orchestrator/spawn.py (after P7 T-0208):
1. run_claude passes --allowedTools with TOOLS[role] (execute keeps Edit/Write; read-only roles keep --disallowedTools too).
2. New tracked file .mcp.worker.json containing only the bus server; run_claude passes --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config .mcp.worker.json (path under ROOT) for every role, so workers never load github or orchestrator MCP schemas. Keep the .mcp.<role>.json override when it exists.
3. Prompts: .orchestrator/prompts/execute.md gains 'Tool-call budget: read only files inside Scope first, then edit; do not re-read a file you already read; run the test script at most twice.' and review.md gains 'The diff is complete. Read a file only when a hunk depends on code outside it; at most 8 tool calls.' Keep the JSON return contract unchanged.
4. Log num_turns from the claude JSON output into the run record (bus.log_run field turns) so the scorecard can show turns per run.
Tests in tests/test_spawn.py: argv contains --allowedTools with the role's list, --strict-mcp-config and the worker config path; the run record carries turns.
acceptance: .mcp.worker.json exists, is tracked, and lists only the bus server
prompts/execute.md and prompts/review.md contain the budget lines and their tests in tests/test_spawn.py or tests/test_hooks.py still render

result.summary:
## Summary

Implemented T-0212: `run_claude` now actually uses the per-role `TOOLS` dict and scopes worker MCP access.

**Changes:**
1. `orchestrator/spawn.py` — `run_claude` adds `--allowedTools <TOOLS[role]>` and `--strict-mcp-config --mcp-config <path>` to the `claude` argv. The mcp-config path prefers `.mcp.<role>.json` when it exists (unchanged override behavior for scout/review/triage), else falls back to the new `.mcp.worker.json`. Replaced the old `shutil.copy(role_cfg, wt/.mcp.json)` mechanism, now redundant since the config is passed explicitly. `--disallowedTools` logic for non-execute roles is unchanged. Also logs `turns=out.get("num_turns", 0)` into `bus.log_run`.
2. `.mcp.worker.json` (new, tracked) — bus server only.
3. `.orchestrator/prompts/execute.md` — added the tool-call budget line.
4. `.orchestrator/prompts/review.md` — added the "diff is complete... at most 8 tool calls" line.
5. `tests/test_spawn.py` — added `test_run_claude_passes_allowed_tools`, `test_run_claude_uses_worker_mcp_config` (+ a role-override variant using `triage` to avoid the `review` role's real secret-shelling out through the patched `Popen`), and `test_run_record_has_turns`.

**Test output:** all 289 tests pass (no failures). `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh .` exits 0.

Committed on `task/T-0212` as `bd0a8e1`.
